title: Bank Competition: Measurement, Decision-Making, and Risk-Taking

scopes.description: Complete author-documented primary-paper and online-appendix workflow, including the datasheet’s manual data construction. The assigned package contains the datasheet and results appendix only, with no executable author program or analysis data.

requirements.description: Author-prepared annual BCE competition measure for the financial-firm sample, linked by GVKEY; the datasheet describes 1996–2010 and a public-on-request data file.

routes.description: The author page offers the BCE data upon request, rather than linking a direct download. The file’s exact columns, firm roster, GVKEY/date coverage and version have not been inspected.
The frozen catalog lists a local cleaned 10-X corpus candidate. No year-specific files, financial-firm population, filing coverage, Item 7 scope, cleaning or GVKEY compatibility were checked.

SEC EDGAR is a public raw-filing route and the author describes a word-count transformation, but the exact financial-firm roster, selected filing set and crosswalk to GVKEY are unresolved; this is not a verified substitute for the prepared BCE file.

requirements.description: The supplementary word-level BCE diagnostics use a separate 20,234-filing EDGAR corpus described as covering 1994–2010; the article data sheet instead gives a 1996–2010 study sample.

routes.description: Public EDGAR filings are available, but the appendix’s exact 20,234 filing roster, 1994–1995 coverage, duplicate/version rules and compatibility with its diagnostics are not established.

actions.description: Request the missing executable workflow and documentation for the primary paper and every included appendix analysis.
steps: Request all SAS, Perl and Stata programs, supporting files, execution order, entry points, file paths, intermediate outputs and the mapping from each main-paper and appendix table/figure to its producing stage.

Request the complete primary article and its Appendices A/C, exact sample/variable definitions, the RegIndex and deregulation inputs, the Lerner-index construction, the local-MSA BCE input/mapping, and the exact Feng Li all-industry file used for Table A2.
Preserve the documented manual stages and the paper’s distinct BCE periods; do not infer missing variables or rebuild the models independently.
validation: Map each supplied table and figure to the returned code/manual stages and their complete producer-consumer inputs.
Confirm the returned code and documentation specify the data fields, identifiers, sample periods and software versions needed to reproduce the author workflow.

actions.description: Request the author-prepared financial-firm BCE file and confirm separate coverage for the appendix’s broader EDGAR diagnostics.
steps: Request the prepared BCE data described on the author page, including its exact GVKEY/year fields, firm roster, 1996–2010 history, 2012 vintage and any access conditions.

Separately resolve the appendix’s 20,234 EDGAR filing corpus for 1994–2010, including the 1994–1995 years, filer roster and filing/version selection; do not treat the 1996–2010 financial-firm product as a substitute.

Check the cataloged local LM10X and SEC parsed/raw resources only for exact coverage and content compatibility before acquiring duplicate public filings; if raw filing inputs are needed, retain the documented keyword, nearby-negation and whole-10-K denominator procedure.
validation: Confirm author-prepared BCE rows contain the required GVKEY and annual measure for the stated financial-firm sample.
Reconcile the appendix diagnostic roster and years independently from the 1996–2010 paper sample before using one product for either purpose.

actions.description: Check the cataloged Dealscan tables against the author’s 2012 data vintage and filters before using them; otherwise obtain the documented vendor inputs.
steps: Confirm the local candidate package, financial-covenant, net-worth-covenant, facility, current-facility-pricing and lender-share tables cover the author’s completed USD original loans and required sample period.

Apply the documented package and facility joins, covenant indicators, spread calculation and lead-arranger restriction only after the table/field mapping is confirmed; if local coverage is incompatible, arrange licensed Dealscan access.
validation: Verify table vintages, package/facility IDs, covenant fields, completion/original/USD filters and lead-arranger fields against the datasheet before constructing the contracting sample.

actions.description: Obtain the exact author-used linking tables that connect Dealscan records and bank securities to the accounting/regulatory panels.
steps: Request both Dealscan FacilityID-to-GVKEY and CompanyID-to-GVKEY linking tables with their provenance, date logic and author vintage.
Request the Federal Reserve Bank of New York PERMCO-to-RSSDID matching table and its key definitions/history; the local catalog does not identify an RSSDID field match.
validation: Confirm that the returned mappings preserve the author’s borrower/lender roles and link the intended PERMCO observations to Y-9C RSSDID/date records.

actions.description: Confirm local Compustat candidate coverage and obtain any missing compatible annual, quarterly, bank or monthly-debt inputs.
steps: Check the local COMP.FUNDA/FUNDQ and COMP.BANK_FUNDQ candidates for author-period coverage, consolidation/format selection, required financial statement items and the 2012 historical vintage. For the bank quarterly data, check the primary 1996–2010 sample separately from possible pre-1996 history, potentially back to 1985, for the VaRA liabilities/assets/equity inputs; do not assume that earlier history is present.
Verify the separate monthly current and long-term debt observations required for EDF; quarterly Compustat fields do not satisfy that monthly input.

Use the author’s prior-to-origination statements and trailing-twelve-month income construction after the sample/crosswalk definitions are supplied; if the local candidates are incomplete, arrange access to the corresponding Compustat products.
validation: Confirm borrower, lender and bank fields, identifiers and dates for the 1996–2010 primary study sample; separately confirm whether quarterly bank liabilities/assets/equity are available from 1985 for the risk construction or ask the authors to specify the effective risk sample period.

actions.description: Verify local CRSP history and obtain the documented daily/monthly equity, index and risk-free inputs.
steps: Check the local CRSP DSF/MSF and DSI/MSI candidates for the author’s 1985–2010 risk and 1996–2010 study periods, required security codes and all return, price, shares and volume fields.
Identify and verify the separate monthly CRSP risk-free series required for EDF; the cataloged stock/index tables do not establish that input.
Retain the documented 40-trading-day, weekly/quarterly construction and market-return rules; obtain missing CRSP products from the author-accessed source if local history is incompatible.
validation: Confirm historical coverage, identifiers, adjusted/unadjusted field semantics and monthly risk-free data before using the candidate tables.

actions.description: Obtain compatible quarterly Y-9C records and resolve the 1996–1999 period not covered by the documented current FFIEC bulk archive.
steps: Check the FFIEC NIC quarter/year downloads for all required 2000–2010 Y-9C fields and BHCK item versions.

For 1996–1999, verify an author-compatible historical archive or the Board FOIA route and request only missing quarters; do not infer that the bulk download’s 2000 start proves older data unavailable.
Join records by the author’s date/RSSDID keys after the exact crosswalk is obtained.
validation: Confirm coverage for every required quarter and fields BHCK 1766, 1975, 1410 and 4635 under the period-specific Y-9C item definitions.

actions.description: Check whether local FRB rate tables contain the author-specific series and full historical weekly inputs before deriving macro spreads.
steps: Inspect only the cataloged daily/monthly FRB rate candidates for the source series, date coverage, 10-year BAA and Treasury definitions, three-month bill and LIBOR history.
Confirm the weekly alignment and source/vintage with the authors; do not equate similar labels such as Moody’s Baa or Eurodollar with a specified author series without confirmation.
validation: Verify the exact series, full 1985–2010 dates, frequency conversion and spread formulas against the returned author specification.

actions.description: Resolve VIX history before the documented VaRA sample start; the official Cboe page currently lists VIX from 1990.
steps: Check whether the author’s actual bank-week sample requires VIX values before 1990 and obtain the exact author-compatible series/history if so.
Do not replace the stated VIX input with the distinct historical VXO series without an author-supported mapping.
validation: Confirm full needed history and index definition for the author’s VaR/CoVaR sample.

actions.description: Request exact identifiers, versions and access routes for the Bloomberg repo and merger/spinoff event inputs.
steps: Request the Bloomberg 3-month general-collateral repo series identifier, frequency and historical file/version.
Request the SCD and Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago merger/spinoff source files, event definitions, dates, and the documented join/exclusion rule.
If an author-prepared event-week intermediate exists, request it with source provenance; do not infer access barriers from the commercial source names.
validation: Confirm the three inputs cover the VaRA observation period and reproduce the author’s week-to-quarter tagging logic.

actions.description: Resolve SAS start-up and version compatibility before future use of the author’s extraction/cleaning stages.
steps: Confirm the exact SAS version expected by the authors and a usable SAS session in the approved environment; the supplied probe ended at TKELS initialization and does not establish that SAS licensing is absent.
After author programs arrive, run only a harmless version/start-up check before any separately authorized study execution.
validation: Record a successful runtime/version query and confirm the author’s required SAS version is supported.

review_notes: There is no analysis_only scope: the package supplies no executable analysis route or compatible complete analysis dataset.
The datasheet’s financial-firm BCE panel (1996–2010), appendix’s 20,234 EDGAR filings (1994–2010), and Li et al. all-industry comparison are separate products and periods.

Catalog hits identify candidate local tables and files only; history, live readability, field semantics and author compatibility remain unverified. No license barrier is inferred from missing catalog matches.
The datasheet’s SAS, Stata and Perl procedures are retained as real workflow stages even though no runnable author code is present; no programs or study data were executed.
